passing_instances.question: Implement a singly linked list with insertion, deletion, and search operations.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented ListNode class with val and next pointers. Added append, insert_at_index, delete_at_index, and search methods. All operations tested with edge cases including empty list and single element.

passing_instances.question: Reverse a string in place without using extra memory.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used two-pointer technique: left at start, right at end. Swapped characters and moved pointers inward until meeting. O(n) time, O(1) space complexity.

passing_instances.question: Find the kth largest element in an unsorted array.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented quickselect algorithm with median-of-three pivot selection. Average O(n) time complexity. Handled duplicate elements and edge cases.

passing_instances.question: Design a distributed caching system like Redis Cluster.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Designed consistent hashing with virtual nodes for load balancing. Included replica sets for fault tolerance, gossip protocol for cluster membership, and lazy rehashing for scaling.

passing_instances.question: Implement a thread-safe bounded blocking queue.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used ReentrantLock with two Conditions (notEmpty, notFull). Implemented put/take with proper wait/notify semantics. Tested with producer-consumer scenarios.

passing_instances.question: Design a relational database schema for an e-commerce platform.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Created normalized schema with tables: users, products, orders, order_items, categories, reviews. Added proper indexes, foreign keys, and constraints. Included ER diagram description.

passing_instances.question: Explain TCP three-way handshake and four-way termination.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Detailed SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK for connection establishment. Explained FIN -> ACK -> FIN -> ACK for termination. Included sequence numbers and state transitions (CLOSED, SYN-SENT, ESTABLISHED, FIN-WAIT).

passing_instances.question: Implement a balanced binary search tree (AVL tree).
passing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented AVLNode with height tracking. Added left/right rotations and balance factor calculations. Insert and delete operations automatically rebalance the tree. Verified with in-order traversal.

passing_instances.question: Implement Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm with a priority queue.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used min-heap for efficient node selection. Implemented with adjacency list representation. Handled non-negative edge weights correctly. Included path reconstruction.

passing_instances.question: Explain and implement JWT authentication.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Described JWT structure (header, payload, signature). Implemented HS256 signing with secret key. Added token generation, validation, and expiration checks. Included refresh token mechanism.

passing_instances.question: Implement a trie (prefix tree) for efficient string prefix matching.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Created TrieNode with children dictionary and is_end_of_word flag. Implemented insert, search, and starts_with operations. Optimized with path compression for common prefixes.

passing_instances.question: Solve the two-sum problem in O(n) time.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used hash map to store complements. Single pass solution: for each number, check if complement exists in map. If yes, return indices; if no, add current number to map.

passing_instances.question: Design a URL shortener service like TinyURL.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used base62 encoding (a-zA-Z0-9) for 6-character short codes. Implemented auto-increment ID generator with Redis for distributed coordination. Included URL validation and expiration support.

passing_instances.question: Implement a read-write lock with fair scheduling.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used ReentrantLock with Condition variables. Implemented writer preference with queue. Tracked active readers/writers and waiting counts. Added tryLock variants with timeout.

passing_instances.question: Explain ACID properties and how they're implemented in PostgreSQL.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Detailed Atomicity (WAL), Consistency (constraints/triggers), Isolation (MVCC), Durability (fsync). Explained transaction levels and their implementations. Mentioned TOAST for large data.

passing_instances.question: Implement a simple HTTP server from scratch.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented TCP server using socket API. Parsed HTTP request line, headers, and body. Supported GET and POST methods. Returned proper status codes and content types.

passing_instances.question: Implement a stack using two queues.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used two queues (main and temp). Push: enqueue to main. Pop: dequeue all except last to temp, dequeue last, swap queues. O(n) pop, O(1) push.

passing_instances.question: Solve the N-Queens problem using backtracking.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented recursive backtracking with column and diagonal tracking. Used sets to track occupied columns, positive diagonals (row-col), and negative diagonals (row+col).

passing_instances.question: Explain and implement OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Described authorization endpoint, token endpoint, refresh flow. Implemented client with PKCE support. Included state parameter for CSRF protection. Explained scope handling.

passing_instances.question: Design a real-time chat application like WhatsApp.
passing_instances.solution_summary: Used WebSocket for real-time communication. Designed message broker with Kafka/RabbitMQ. Included presence tracking with Redis. Designed database schema for messages and contacts.

failing_instances.question: Implement a Paxos consensus algorithm from scratch.
failing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented proposer, acceptor, and learner roles. However, the implementation had a bug in the prepare phase that caused livelock in certain edge cases.
failing_instances.failure_reason: Livelock during prepare phase with multiple proposers

failing_instances.question: Implement a general-purpose constraint satisfaction solver.
failing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented backtracking with forward checking and AC-3 algorithm. However, the variable ordering heuristic didn't handle certain constraint graphs optimally.

failing_instances.question: Implement a BGP router with route selection.
failing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented basic BGP FSM and message parsing. However, the route selection algorithm didn't correctly apply all tie-breaking rules in the correct order.

failing_instances.question: Implement a B+ tree index structure for a database.
failing_instances.solution_summary: Implemented B+ tree with range query support. However, there was a bug in the split algorithm that caused index corruption during heavy insertion workloads.
